instruction: Fix `parse_ini` in `parselib/ini.py` so a repeated section header merges into the existing section instead of wiping it. The current code assigns a fresh empty dict each time a section header appears, so keys defined before a second `[section]` header are lost.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/parselib/ini.py b/parselib/ini.py
--- a/parselib/ini.py
+++ b/parselib/ini.py
@@ -20,7 +20,7 @@
             continue
         if line.startswith("[") and line.endswith("]"):
             section = line[1:-1].strip()
-            result[section] = {}
+            result.setdefault(section, {})
             continue
         pair = parse_kv(line)
         if pair is None:
